mapper.select: SELECT t.TODO_ID, t.OWNER_USER_ID, t.TITLE, t.DESCRIPTION, t.PRIORITY, t.DUE_DATE, t.DUE_TIME, t.IS_COMPLETED, t.COMPLETED_AT, t.SORT_ORDER, t.REPEAT_TYPE, t.REPEAT_INTERVAL, t.REPEAT_DAYS, t.REPEAT_END_DATE, t.NEXT_DUE_DATE, t.PARENT_TODO_ID, t.TRANSFERRED_FROM_USER_ID, t.TRANSFERRED_AT, t.USE_YN, t.CREATED_AT, t.CREATED_BY, t.UPDATED_AT, t.UPDATED_BY, u.NAME AS OWNER_USER_NAME, u.USERNAME AS OWNER_USERNAME, tf.NAME AS TRANSFERRED_FROM_USER_NAME, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_TODO_SHARE WHERE TODO_ID = t.TODO_ID) AS SHARE_COUNT FROM TB_TODO t INNER JOIN TB_USER u ON t.OWNER_USER_ID = u.USER_ID LEFT JOIN TB_USER tf ON t.TRANSFERRED_FROM_USER_ID = tf.USER_ID WHERE t.TODO_ID = #{todoId} AND t.USE_YN = 'Y'

SELECT t.TODO_ID, t.OWNER_USER_ID, t.TITLE, t.DESCRIPTION, t.PRIORITY, t.DUE_DATE, t.DUE_TIME, t.IS_COMPLETED, t.SORT_ORDER, t.REPEAT_TYPE, t.CREATED_AT, u.NAME AS OWNER_USER_NAME FROM TB_TODO t INNER JOIN TB_USER u ON t.OWNER_USER_ID = u.USER_ID WHERE t.OWNER_USER_ID = #{ownerUserId} AND t.USE_YN = 'Y' AND t.IS_COMPLETED = FALSE AND t.DUE_DATE = CURDATE() ORDER BY t.DUE_TIME ASC, t.SORT_ORDER ASC

SELECT t.TODO_ID, t.OWNER_USER_ID, t.TITLE, t.DESCRIPTION, t.PRIORITY, t.DUE_DATE, t.DUE_TIME, t.IS_COMPLETED, t.SORT_ORDER, t.REPEAT_TYPE, t.CREATED_AT, u.NAME AS OWNER_USER_NAME FROM TB_TODO t INNER JOIN TB_USER u ON t.OWNER_USER_ID = u.USER_ID WHERE t.OWNER_USER_ID = #{ownerUserId} AND t.USE_YN = 'Y' AND t.IS_COMPLETED = FALSE AND (t.DUE_DATE < CURDATE() OR (t.DUE_DATE = CURDATE() AND t.DUE_TIME < CURTIME())) ORDER BY t.DUE_DATE ASC, t.DUE_TIME ASC

SELECT t.TODO_ID, t.OWNER_USER_ID, t.TITLE, t.DESCRIPTION, t.PRIORITY, t.DUE_DATE, t.DUE_TIME, t.IS_COMPLETED, t.SORT_ORDER, t.TRANSFERRED_FROM_USER_ID, t.TRANSFERRED_AT, t.CREATED_AT, u.NAME AS OWNER_USER_NAME, tf.NAME AS TRANSFERRED_FROM_USER_NAME FROM TB_TODO t INNER JOIN TB_USER u ON t.OWNER_USER_ID = u.USER_ID LEFT JOIN TB_USER tf ON t.TRANSFERRED_FROM_USER_ID = tf.USER_ID WHERE t.OWNER_USER_ID = #{ownerUserId} AND t.USE_YN = 'Y' AND t.TRANSFERRED_FROM_USER_ID IS NOT NULL ORDER BY t.TRANSFERRED_AT DESC

SELECT t.TODO_ID, t.OWNER_USER_ID, t.TITLE, t.DUE_DATE, t.DUE_TIME, t.IS_COMPLETED, t.COMPLETED_AT, t.PARENT_TODO_ID, t.CREATED_AT FROM TB_TODO t WHERE t.PARENT_TODO_ID = #{parentTodoId} AND t.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY t.DUE_DATE ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_TODO WHERE OWNER_USER_ID = #{ownerUserId} AND USE_YN = 'Y'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_TODO WHERE OWNER_USER_ID = #{ownerUserId} AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND IS_COMPLETED = FALSE

mapper.select: SELECT t.TODO_ID, t.OWNER_USER_ID, t.TITLE, t.DESCRIPTION, t.PRIORITY, t.DUE_DATE, t.DUE_TIME, t.REPEAT_TYPE, t.REPEAT_INTERVAL, t.REPEAT_DAYS, t.REPEAT_END_DATE, t.NEXT_DUE_DATE, t.CREATED_BY FROM TB_TODO t WHERE t.USE_YN = 'Y' AND t.IS_COMPLETED = FALSE AND t.REPEAT_TYPE IS NOT NULL AND t.REPEAT_TYPE != 'NONE' AND t.PARENT_TODO_ID IS NULL AND (t.NEXT_DUE_DATE IS NULL OR t.NEXT_DUE_DATE <= #{targetDate}) AND (t.REPEAT_END_DATE IS NULL OR t.REPEAT_END_DATE >= #{targetDate})
